en.headline: 390 own commits across nine repos, 662 automated commits, 47 issue actions
en.teaser: Most of the window went into the daily-summary pipeline, three OpenCode skills and a new translation extension, plus a steady stream of bug reports to OpenChamber and OpenCode.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-02 with data for every day. Across all repositories the account recorded 390 own commits, 662 automated commits, 47 issue actions and no pull requests or reviews. Work concentrated on the personal `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` repository and on a set of OpenCode-related skills and tools, while a parallel stream of bug reports and feature requests went to upstream projects.

### Daily summary pipeline

Most of the commit volume in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` went into the daily AI summary pipeline. Fixes covered inline Markdown rendering in release notes, inline code and bold support in summary bodies, a deterministic truncation path that raised the success rate on heavy days, and disabling reasoning so that `max_tokens` no longer consumed the whole budget and left the content empty. A mock regression test was added and the commit step was hardened against push collisions.

### OpenCode skills and tooling

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` built the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, moved plans into `.openchamber/plans`, normalized line endings to LF and shipped four releases up to v1.2.0, including a JSON envelope for all actions and a fix to the diverged-skill summary. `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` added agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts, atomic snapshot writes, version-badge drift checks and priced accounting, reaching v3.0.0 with a single entry point. `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` split into cooperating skills, added a thin `meld.py` CLI, explicit handling for blocked sources and validator hints, and released v0.2.0 through v0.4.0. `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` accumulated a knowledge base covering OpenCode V2 distribution, authentication and Windows path issues.

### New projects and smaller repos

`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` was initialized and grew an MV3 skeleton with bilingual page rendering, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker, a provider protocol layer and glossary pipeline, then dropped selection translation in favor of page translation only. `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` corrected skill invocation facts across docs and samples and shipped v1.15.4 and v1.15.5. `sogeisetsu/myBlog` added OpenChamber capture samples.

### Upstream reports

Issue activity was mostly upstream. In `openchamber/openchamber` reports covered MCP settings omissions, session retention hints, quote-card navigation, file-view commenting, context panel percentages, capture resolution, unlinking agent-linked items and model switching. In `anomalyco/opencode` the reports concerned Windows CLI access, MiMo vision handling and stale images, and worktree removal. Smaller reports went to `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim`, `iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI`, `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills` and `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch`.

highlights.text: Opened and closed a temporary smoke-test issue for the opencode /oc flow.
First stable release of the skill_management plugin, freezing the 1.x surface.
Collapsed the skill into one entry point with run, report, check and apply verbs.
Added the meld.py wrapper over the six gate scripts and downgraded some gates.
Reported that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Reported that MiMo models advertise image input while the Go endpoint rejects images.
Opened a request to fix the OpenCode v2 skills install path and add an mcp target.

zh.headline: 本人提交 390 次、自动提交 662 次，47 次 issue 互动
zh.teaser: 这段时间主要投入每日摘要流水线、三个 OpenCode 技能和一个新的翻译扩展，同时向 OpenChamber 与 OpenCode 提交了一批缺陷报告。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-04 至 2026-11-02，每天都有数据。全部仓库合计本人提交 390 次、自动提交 662 次、47 次 issue 互动，没有拉取请求和评审。工作集中在个人仓库 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 以及一组 OpenCode 相关技能和工具上，同时向上游项目提交了较多缺陷报告和功能请求。

### 每日摘要流水线

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的提交量主要花在每日 AI 摘要流水线上。修复内容包括发布说明中的内联 Markdown 渲染、摘要正文支持内联代码和加粗、用确定性截断提升重日成功率，以及关闭 reasoning 以免 `max_tokens` 被思维链占满导致正文为空。此外补充了 mock 回归测试，并加固提交步骤以应对 push 冲突。

### OpenCode 技能与工具

`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，把计划迁到 `.openchamber/plans`，统一换行符为 LF，并发布到 v1.2.0，其中包含所有动作改为 JSON 信封以及 diverged 技能摘要的修复。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 增加了 agent 发现与快照摘要脚本、原子快照写入、版本徽章漂移检查和计价核算，最终发布 v3.0.0，收敛为单一入口。`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 拆分为协作技能，加入 `meld.py` 薄 CLI、受限来源的显式处理和校验提示，发布 v0.2.0 至 v0.4.0。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 积累了一套知识库，覆盖 OpenCode V2 分发、认证和 Windows 路径问题。

### 新项目与较小仓库

`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 从初始化开始，搭建了 MV3 骨架，包含双语页面渲染、分块切分、熔断器、提供方协议层和术语表流水线，随后去掉划词翻译只保留整页翻译。`sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 在文档和示例中修正技能调用方式，发布 v1.15.4 和 v1.15.5。`sogeisetsu/myBlog` 补充了 OpenChamber 截图样例。

### 上游报告

issue 互动主要发生在上游。`openchamber/openchamber` 的报告涉及 MCP 设置遗漏、会话保留提示、引用卡片跳转、文件视图评论、上下文面板百分比、截图分辨率、解除关联以及模型切换。`anomalyco/opencode` 的报告涉及 Windows 桌面运行 CLI、MiMo 视觉读取旧图和 worktree 删除受阻。另有少量报告提交到 `alvinunreal/oh-my-opencode-slim`、`iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI`、`OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills` 和 `OpenSenseNova/SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch`。

highlights.text: 新开并关闭了一个用于 opencode /oc 流程的临时冒烟测试 issue。
skill_management 插件的首个稳定版，冻结 1.x 的接口范围。
把技能收敛为单一入口，提供 run、report、check、apply 四个动词。
为六个门禁脚本加上 meld.py 包装，并下调了部分门禁。
报告设置中的 MCP 页面遗漏了 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
报告 MiMo 模型声明支持图片输入，但 Go 端点拒绝所有图片。
提出修复 OpenCode v2 技能安装路径并增加 mcp 目标的请求。
